content.content:
INC-94  Back-to-back berth bookings are rejected
status: open   priority: P2   area: berths   reported: 2026-08-18 by berth-planning

Planners cannot book a vessel onto a berth at the exact time the previous vessel leaves
it. A booking that ends at noon and the next one starting at noon do not overlap, but
the schedule reports a clash.

Acceptance:
  The book method of BerthSchedule accepts a booking that starts exactly when another
  booking on the same berth ends (and one that ends exactly when another starts); bookings
  that genuinely overlap on the same berth are still refused.

Files:
  src/berths/schedule.ts

content.text: The bug is in `overlaps` — it uses `<=` on both ends, so a booking ending exactly when another starts is treated as overlapping. Fixing to strict inequality on one side (or both) will treat touching bookings as non-overlapping while still catching genuine overlaps.

content.text:
All 27 tests pass, including the existing overlap check and the new back-to-back booking test.

Fixed INC-94: `overlaps` in `src/berths/schedule.ts` used `<=` on both bounds, so a booking ending exactly when another started was flagged as a clash. Changed both comparisons to `<`, so touching bookings are now accepted while genuine overlaps are still rejected. Added a regression test in `test/berths.test.ts`.
